{{Season|Summer}} |Sell Price = 0 |gPrice = ''Not sold'' |jPrice = ''Not sold'' |tPrice = ''Not sold'' }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Spring}} and {{Season|Summer}}. Mature plants yield [[Salal Berry]] after 13 days and continue to produce every 4 days. Seeds cannot be purchased, but they can be obtained by digging up [[Stardew:Artifact Spots|Artifact Spots]] in the [[Secret Woods]] and by placing Salal Berry in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants produce 2 – 4 Salal Berries per harvest, with a 2% chance of extra produce per harvest and a 3% chance of extra harvest per [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Salal Berry}} {{clear}}
